svg.title: AI co-authorship on GitHub: indexed commits per month by agent
svg.desc: Commits indexed by GitHub code search whose message carries each agent's Co-authored-by trailer, per calendar month, log scale. Hollow markers are partial counts where the search timed out.
svg.text: AI co-authorship on GitHub, by agent
Commits indexed by GitHub search whose message carries the agent's trailer, per calendar month (committer date). Log scale.
partial count: GitHub's search timed out (incomplete_results), the true number is higher
